criteria.task: Classify 02:00:00:00:00:01, 01:00:5E:00:00:01 and all-FF using first-octet low bits.
criteria.purpose: Assess this concrete Ethernet mechanism, misconception and evidence boundary independently.

reasoning: Classify 02:00:00:00:00:01, 01:00:5E:00:00:01 and all-FF using first-octet low bits.
